titulo: Three ways to point the way
caption:
Three ways to point the way

I used to point and say over there. Then I started giving a landmark and one turn.

Directions stick when they name something you can see, and a landmark is easier to follow than a string of lefts and rights.

For whoever gives directions with a landmark.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A terracotta room with a staircase on the right and a navy figure that asks the station? in each of three labeled scenes. The wave: a teal figure says over there. and the navy one narrows its eyes. The maze: a brown figure trembles and says left, right, left? and the navy one looks down. The landmark: an ink-black figure says past the bakery, turn left., and the navy one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of giving directions. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
